# Lexi: Vocabulary Crosswords

> An English vocabulary app for iPhone and iPad. Personalized crossword puzzles combine typed sentence-based recall with per-word spaced repetition. The core app is free with optional Premium purchases.

## Product
- [Overview](https://lexivocab.app/): gameplay, illustrated word cards, and a sky of learned words.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lexi-vocabulary-crosswords/id6740172587): platform availability and current release information.
- [Premium](https://lexivocab.app/premium/): contrastive learning drills for supported word groups and additional companion designs.
- [Lexi vs. Vocabulary](https://lexivocab.app/lexi-vs-vocabulary/): a sourced comparison of word discovery, typed in-context recall, adaptive review schedules, and synonym nuance. Vocabulary means the Monkey Taps app, not Vocabulary.com.
- [Blog](https://lexivocab.app/blog/): practical vocabulary learning guides.

## Vocabulary and learning
The word bank has about 20,000 words. Illustrated cards introduce vocabulary with an image, definition, and example sentence. Lexi is designed for lasting vocabulary expansion and an active vocabulary for thinking, speaking, and writing. It tracks per-word review progress and due dates, adjusts intervals to performance, and asks users to retrieve words from changing sentence-and-meaning clues. Contrastive learning trains distinctions between easily confused words. Lexi is not affiliated with Monkey Taps. No comparative learning-outcome study is claimed.

## Comparison evidence
Vocabulary by Monkey Taps emphasizes word discovery, widgets, reminders, collections, and practice. Its August 2026 official blog claims built-in spaced repetition but does not describe adaptive per-word scheduling or a knowledge model. The comparison page separates those public claims from the creator’s hands-on observations of multiple-choice exercises. Lexi’s advantages are explained through its concrete learning mechanics; Long-term vocabulary expansion means continuing to add words and maintain learned words through adaptive reviews: successful recall permits longer intervals, while revealing a forgotten word brings its review sooner. This is a maintained learning process, not a claim of perfect recall at every moment or a measured head-to-head learning outcome.
